subject: SOC 2 Type II report request: audit window clarification + evidence checklist
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Megan Lee <megan.lee@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request: audit window clarification + evidence checklist

Hi Megan,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. Acme is listed as an approved vendor for one of our customers and we need to validate Redwood's SOC 2 Type II coverage as part of their procurement. Can you confirm whether you can provide: 

- SOC 2 Type II report for the period covering 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31 (preferred), or the most recent available Type II period;
- A signed bridge letter if the report period doesn't fully cover the customer's required dates;
- A short evidence index (high level) that maps common requests (user provisioning, change control, logging/monitoring, backups, incident response) to artifacts we can review.

To speed this, I attached two quick files: a bridge-letter template we typically accept and an "initial evidence index" spreadsheet that lists the usual artifacts and preferred formats. If you prefer SFTP or a secure Drive link, include transfer instructions and we can coordinate with our security ops team.

Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx, redwood_initial_evidence_index.xlsx, secure_transfer_instructions.txt

Would it be possible to have the report + any bridge letter by next Friday (2026-06-26)? If that timeline is tight please let me know the earliest feasible date and which artifacts you can share immediately.

Thanks —
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform

From: Megan Lee <megan.lee@acmecloud.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request: audit window clarification + evidence checklist

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the clear list and the templates. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Audit period: Our most recent Type II report covers 2025-11-01 through 2026-04-30. We can provide that report.
2) Bridge letter: We can issue a bridge letter covering 2026-05-01 through 2026-06-30 (signed by our CFO). Will that be acceptable to your customer?
3) Evidence index: We can provide an artifact inventory (PDF manifest) and a subset of redacted artifacts for the high-priority controls you listed (provisioning screenshots, change runbook, logging dashboard exports, backup runbooks).

Transfer options: we can (a) upload to a pre-shared SFTP, (b) provide a time-limited Google Drive link, or (c) deliver via our vendor portal. We prefer SFTP for larger sets.

Timeline: We can deliver the Type II report and bridge letter by 2026-06-25 and an initial artifact set (manifest + a handful of samples) by 2026-06-26 if SFTP details are provided today.

We'll also redact any customer-identifying data before share.

Would you accept the timeline above? If so please send SFTP creds or a Drive share link and we'll start the transfer.

Best,
Megan
Megan Lee
Vendor Risk Manager, Acme Cloud
megan.lee@acmecloud.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Megan Lee <megan.lee@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request: audit window clarification + evidence checklist

Megan —

Appreciate the quick response and the clear timeline. The period you listed (2025-11-01 to 2026-04-30) plus a bridge for 2026-05-01 to 2026-06-30 should satisfy the customer. SFTP works for us. 

SFTP details: please SFTP to sftp.redwood-secure.com and put files under /incoming/Acme-SOC2/<your-org>. We'll send a one-time user and password via our Secrets team and rotate credentials immediately after the upload. If you'd rather use a time-limited Drive link, we can accept that as well.

Attached are three items to help: 
- redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx — editable template for the bridge letter (signature line for CFO)
- redwood_initial_evidence_index.xlsx — checklist we use for first-pass triage (columns: artifact, preferred format, redaction guidance, priority)
- secure_transfer_instructions.txt — example SFTP username format, preferred file naming, and MD5 checksum guidance

Standard reply snippets — feel free to reuse verbatim when you share artifacts: 
> 1) "We are sharing Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2025-11-01 to 2026-04-30. Attached: SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-20250430.pdf. A bridge letter covering 2026-05-01 to 2026-06-30 signed by the CFO is included: Redwood-BridgeLetter-20260624.pdf."

> 2) "Initial artifact manifest attached (Redwood-Artifact-Manifest.pdf). For larger artifacts we have provided SFTP upload locations and checksums; we can also provide temporary Drive links on request."

If you hit any redaction questions, loop in Rishi (cc'd) for specifics on telemetry/PII handling. Kimberly, Monica and I will track deliverables on our side.

Thanks —
Sergio

Attachments referenced: redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx, redwood_initial_evidence_index.xlsx, secure_transfer_instructions.txt

From: Megan Lee <megan.lee@acmecloud.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmecloud.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request: audit window clarification + evidence checklist

Sergio —

Confirmed. We will: 
- Upload SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-20260430.pdf and Redwood-BridgeLetter-20260624.pdf to the SFTP by end of day 2026-06-25.
- Provide the initial artifact manifest (Redwood-Artifact-Manifest.pdf) and three sample artifacts (user_prov_sample.pdf, change_control_runbook.pdf, logging_dashboard_export.csv) by 2026-06-26.

SFTP point-of-contact: Oliver Grant (oliver.grant@acmecloud.com). He will send credentials and the target path within the hour.

Thanks for the templates — they sped up internal approvals. We'll let you know once upload completes.

Best,
Megan

---
Forwarded note (from Oliver): credentials will arrive from secure@acmecloud.com. Expect username format acme_redwood_<shortid>. Use provided MD5 checksums to verify large files.
